A '''floor-polish droid''' was a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] used to keep floors and surfaces clean.

==Behind the scenes==
The floor-polish droid was mentioned in the [[2008]] novel [[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']].
